testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.execution.ExecutionReconcilerTest

testcase.name: C1 idle has no record and mints no execution
prompt ambiguity is deferred untouched and reconciliation is idempotent
an evidence gap is unknown not lost
boundary two lost acknowledgement becomes ambiguous with no auto resend
C2 C3 with no evidence are unknown not lost
an ambiguous send stays visible through three restart cycles
a failed probe is an evidence gap not a loss
recovered outcomes can be adopted by the controller without claiming a live engine
generation mismatch and missing generation never adopt into a replacement engine
confirmed terminal history and confirmed absence are distinguished
boundary one intent before send recovers as visibly unsent
